name: Jujutsu Beatdown
desc:
Beat down on your boys and become the Strongest 👑😈  

📱💻🎮 SUPPORTS ALL DEVICES! (CONSOLE - MOBILE - PC)
Leave a like and favoriting the game to support us for more updates and improvements! We hope you enjoy :)  
Join the community server below in social links to leave us feedback and suggestions, we read everything!  

🖥️ Controls  
M1 - Melee Combo  
Q - Dash  
Forward Q (+ Jump) - Dash Attack (or Air Counter)  
F - Block  
G - Awaken  
E - Cursed Energy + Chance of Black Flash - Variants + Enhancements  
Ctrl - Slide
